final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT z.city AS city, COUNT(*) AS c FROM attendance a JOIN member m ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member JOIN zip_code z ON z.zip_code = m.zip GROUP BY z.city), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(c) AS t FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.city AS city, s1.c AS c, CAST(s1.c AS REAL) / s2.t AS r FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.t IS NOT NULL AND s2.t <> 0), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(r) AS av FROM s3), s5 AS (SELECT s3.city, s3.c, s3.r, s3.r - s4.av AS d FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.av IS NOT NULL WHERE s3.r > s4.av) SELECT AVG(c), AVG(r), AVG(d) FROM s5
